info.name: University Management System API
info.description:
Full REST API collection for the University Management System backend (Node.js + Express + PostgreSQL + Prisma), matching /api/v1.

## Getting started
1. Set `baseUrl` (collection variable) to your running server, e.g. `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`.
2. Run **Auth > Login** with a seeded demo account — this automatically stores `accessToken` / `refreshToken` / `userId` as collection variables.
3. All other requests inherit Bearer auth from the collection automatically.
4. Requests that create resources (Department, Program, Course, Semester, Section, Enrollment, Exam, Result, Invoice, Payment) automatically capture the new record's `id` into the matching collection variable (e.g. `departmentId`, `courseId`) so downstream requests referencing `{{id}}` work with no manual copy-pasting.

## Demo credentials (from the seed script)
All seeded accounts share the password `Passw0rd!123`.
- ADMIN: `admin@university.edu`
- FACULTY: `rahim.uddin@university.edu` (and 4 more)
- STUDENT: `arif.rahman@student.university.edu` (and 19 more)

## Notes
- Variables like `studentProfileId`, `facultyProfileId`, `prerequisiteCourseId`, `targetUserId`, `attendanceId`, `notificationId` are not auto-captured (they come from list endpoints or the seed data) — copy the relevant id from a GET response into the collection variable before running dependent requests.
- The frontend/Postman never marks a payment as successful directly — only the `/payments/webhook` endpoint (called by the real gateway) does.
